run_colmap_visualization: run the script to visualize a COLMAP sparse reconstruction in the Rerun 3D viewer
run_colmap_with_images: run the script with --show_images to display camera images alongside the 3D point cloud
run_colmap_with_keypoints: run the script with --show_keypoints to overlay 2D keypoints on camera images in the viewer
run_colmap_filtered: run the script with --filter and --min_track_length to filter noisy 3D points by track length
run_colmap_custom_sparse: run the script with --sparse_subdir to load a COLMAP reconstruction from a non-default subdirectory
